# Ahrefs

> Ahrefs is an all-in-one AI marketing platform providing SEO tools, competitor analysis, keyword research, content optimization, and performance tracking for organic search and AI visibility.

Ahrefs offers a comprehensive suite of tools for SEO professionals, content marketers, and agencies to analyze competitors, research keywords, track rankings, audit websites, and optimize content for both search engines and AI systems. The platform integrates Google Search Console data and provides privacy-friendly analytics alternatives.

## Key Topics

- SEO Tools
- Competitor Analysis
- Keyword Research
- Rank Tracking
- Content Marketing
- Technical SEO
- AI Content Optimization
- Brand Monitoring
- Web Analytics
- Organic Search
- Google Search Console
- Site Auditing
- SEO Reporting
- Local SEO
- AI Visibility

## Core SEO Tools

- [Site Explorer](https://ahrefs.com/site-explorer): Analyze competitor websites' organic traffic, backlinks, and paid ads
- [Keywords Explorer](https://ahrefs.com/keywords-explorer): Keyword research tool with 28.7B topics and clustering at scale
- [Rank Tracker](https://ahrefs.com/rank-tracker): Track keyword rankings globally across 190+ locations
- [Site Audit](https://ahrefs.com/site-audit): Free SEO audit tool identifying 170+ issues for websites
- [Website Performance](https://ahrefs.com/website-performance): Audit and monitor website SEO health, speed, and performance

## Content & AI Tools

- [Content Explorer](https://ahrefs.com/content-explorer): Find top-performing content and link prospects in your niche
- [AI Content Helper](https://ahrefs.com/ai-content-helper): AI writing assistant optimizing content for Google and ChatGPT
- [Content Marketing](https://ahrefs.com/content-marketing): Create and optimize high-performing content with Ahrefs tools
- [Social Media Manager](https://ahrefs.com/social-media-manager): Schedule and manage social media content across platforms

## Monitoring & Intelligence

- [Brand Radar](https://ahrefs.com/brand-radar): Monitor AI visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and 6 AI tools
- [Search Console Insights](https://ahrefs.com/gsc-insights): Connect Google Search Console to unlock hidden opportunities
- [Web Analytics](https://ahrefs.com/web-analytics): Privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative without cookies
- [Competitive Intelligence](https://ahrefs.com/use-cases/competitive-intelligence): Guide on using Ahrefs for competitive intelligence and trends

## Reporting & Dashboards

- [Dashboard](https://ahrefs.com/dashboard): Monitor SEO projects, track performance, and measure progress
- [Reporting](https://ahrefs.com/reporting): Create custom SEO reports and monitor key performance metrics
- [Report Builder](https://ahrefs.com/report-builder): Create and share automated SEO reports with teams and clients
- [Portfolios](https://ahrefs.com/portfolios): Group and monitor multiple URLs with competitor tracking

## Local SEO

- [Local SEO](https://ahrefs.com/local-seo): Dominate local rankings with tools for local optimization
- [Google Business Profile Monitor](https://ahrefs.com/gbp-monitor): Monitor Google Business Profile performance and local rankings

## Getting Started

- [Use Cases](https://ahrefs.com/use-cases): Overview of Ahrefs use cases for SEO, PPC, and marketers
